event_summary: A pink rectangular block is lowered from above onto a blue horizontal block supported by two vertical blocks, then the holder moves upward while the block arrangement remains standing.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a blue horizontal block spanning between a red vertical block on the left and a yellow vertical block on the right on a wooden tabletop. A pink rectangular block is partly visible near the top of the frame and descends toward the blue block while attached to or near a dark blue and black holder. The pink block approaches at a slight angle, touches the top of the blue block near the center, becomes more vertical, and remains upright on top of the blue block. The dark holder then moves upward and out of view. The red, yellow, blue, and pink blocks remain visibly intact and upright through the end.

reasons: The blue, red, and yellow blocks are clearly visible on the tabletop.
The pink block is only partly visible near the top edge of the frame.
The holder above the pink block is not fully visible in the first frame.
